shields_note: Posted 'Shields (10)' after the 60 (under the Strategy heading); all ten are named and dested as the Reflections III Defensive Shields.
notes: The post says this is the deck Winkelhaus used to win FreedomCon (the 2001 Decipher World Championship): it lost game 1 to Matt Berta's Hunt Down, then won the next 6 games. The description calls it 'The deck i used at worlds'.
Starting cards are not marked in the post; the objective, Heading For The Medical Frigate and An Unusual Amount Of Fear are the deck's starting cards and count toward the 60.
Posted 'EPP Qui-Gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber, a Theed Palace card (released 12 December 2001, after this post and after FreedomCon 2001); kept as posted.

Posted 'EPP Luke', 'EPP Obi' and 'EPP Leia' dested Luke With Lightsaber, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber and Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'CC' sites dested the Light Cloud City sites; 'Taws Khaa' dested Tawss Khaa; 'Squadron Assignment' dested Squadron Assignments.
Posted 'Sorry About the Mess & Blaster Profiency', 'Houjix & Out of Nowhere', 'Shocking Information & Grimtaash' and 'The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach' dested the Reflections II combo interrupts.
The ten Defensive Shields posted after the 60 dested the Reflections III shield pages (several share names with older Effects).
